tables.name: daily_agg_reviews
tables.description:
This model aggregates the total number of reviews and their sentiment for each day. It is an incremental model that processes new data daily. 
A surrogate key is generated based on the review sentiment and review date to ensure uniqueness. The model only processes reviews from the current date when running incrementally.

columns.name: REVIEW_TOTALS
columns.description: The total count of reviews for a specific sentiment on a given date.

columns.name: REVIEW_SENTIMENT
columns.description: The sentiment of the review (e.g., positive, neutral, or negative).

columns.name: REVIEW_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the review was submitted.

columns.name: DATE_SENTIMENT_ID
columns.description: A surrogate key generated from the review sentiment and the review date, ensuring uniqueness for each date-sentiment combination.

tables.name: mom_agg_reviews
tables.description:
This model calculates the total number of reviews and their sentiment over a rolling 30-day window, providing month-over-month (MoM) comparison metrics. 
The model aggregates review data over the past 30 days and calculates the percentage change in review totals compared to the previous month. 
It uses a surrogate key generated from the aggregation date and review sentiment to ensure uniqueness.

columns.name: REVIEW_TOTALS
columns.description: The total count of reviews for a specific sentiment during the 30-day aggregation window.

columns.name: REVIEW_SENTIMENT
columns.description: The sentiment of the review (e.g., positive, neutral, or negative).

columns.name: AGGREGATION_DATE
columns.description: The aggregation date representing the date on which the 30-day rolling aggregation was calculated.

columns.name: MOM
columns.description: The month-over-month (MoM) percentage change in review totals compared to the previous 30 days.

columns.name: DATE_SENTIMENT_ID
columns.description: A surrogate key generated from the aggregation date and review sentiment, ensuring uniqueness for each date-sentiment combination.

tables.name: dim_listings_hosts
tables.description:
This model combines listing information with host details by joining the `dim_listings` and `dim_hosts` tables.
It merges the data based on `HOST_ID`, ensuring the most recent `UPDATED_AT` timestamp between the two tables is captured.
A surrogate key is generated for each unique combination of `LISTING_ID` and `HOST_ID`.

columns.name: CREATED_AT
columns.description: The date and time when the listing was created.

columns.name: UPDATED_AT
columns.description:
The most recent update time between the listing and the host. 
It takes the greater value of `listings_cte.UPDATED_AT` and `hosts_cte.UPDATED_AT`.

columns.name: LISTING_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the listing.

columns.name: LISTING_NAME
columns.description: The name of the listing, typically used to describe the property.

columns.name: ROOM_TYPE
columns.description: The type of room being offered (e.g., entire home, private room, etc.).

columns.name: minimum_nights
columns.description: The minimum number of nights required to book the listing.

columns.name: PRICE
columns.description: The price per night for the listing.

columns.name: HOST_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the host of the listing.

columns.name: HOST_NAME
columns.description: The name of the host managing the listing.

columns.name: IS_SUPERHOST
columns.description: Indicates whether the host is a 'Superhost', a status awarded for high ratings and performance.

columns.name: LISTING_HOST_ID
columns.description:
A surrogate key generated for each unique combination of `LISTING_ID` and `HOST_ID`.
This key is used to uniquely identify the relationship between a listing and its host.
